name: rev-engine-prime
description: A pull request reviewer packaged as a ReviewBench agent container

scripts.test:linux: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/repo -w /repo node:24-slim sh -c 'apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git jq >/dev/null && setpriv --reuid=node --regid=node --init-groups env HOME=/tmp GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="*" node --test "tests/*.test.ts"'
